trigger: 2001 Indian Parliament attack by JeM — itself enabled by Masood Azhar's release in IC-814 (1999). Ajay Sanyal (IB Director) authorises operation to map and dismantle the Karachi-Lyari-ISI nexus responsible.
objective_film1: Infiltrate Rehman Dakait's Lyari criminal network; expose the Dakait-Jamali political link; map the ISI FICN (fake Indian currency) distribution network; gather actionable intelligence on the terror financing chain connecting Lyari → JeM/LeT → ISI → planned attacks on India.
objective_film2: Avenge 26/11. Locate and neutralise Major Iqbal (ISI handler) and 26/11 planners (Azam Cheema, Sajid Mir) who were protected under Pakistan's state apparatus. Operate under 'Naya Bharat' / 'ghar mein ghusna' political mandate.
real_world_parallel: Composite of real events: IC-814 (1999), 2001 Parliament attack, real Lyari gang wars, LTF operations, 26/11 (2008), Operation Lyari (2012), deaths of various 26/11-linked individuals (2022+)

phases.name: Infiltration
phases.description: Jaskirat Singh Rangi (as Hamza Ali Mazari) enters Pakistan via Torkham. Establishes cover in Lyari, Karachi. Makes contact with field handler Mohammed Aalam. First intelligence reports sent to Ajay Sanyal.

phases.name: Trust Building
phases.description: Hamza deepens cover by embedding in Dakait's gang periphery. LTF pressure (from SP Aslam) begins creating cover-integrity risk. Hamza must navigate both Dakait's paranoia and LTF raids.
phases.cpm_bottleneck_note: This phase is the CPM bottleneck. Dakait's trust-building took significantly longer than optimal because Hamza was operating without parallel support on the Jamali political-intelligence track.

phases.name: Intelligence Extraction
phases.description: Hamza extracts the Dakait-Jamali-ISI FICN link. 26/11 happens while Hamza is still in field — he has partial intel that wasn't acted on. Dakait is killed (2009 police encounter). Hamza is extracted.
phases.26_11_intel_failure_note: The film's central tragedy: Hamza had intel on the 26/11 network. The CPM analysis would show that if the Jamali political-intelligence track had been parallelised earlier (Phase 2), the warning could have reached Sanyal 3–6 weeks faster — potentially before 26/11.

phases.name: The Revenge (Film 2)
phases.description: Post-2014, under Naya Bharat mandate. Sanyal authorises targeting Major Iqbal and the 26/11 planners. Uzair Baloch (Rehman's successor) is a new target/asset. Zahoor Mistry (IC-814 hijacker, still in Karachi) is a target. SP Aslam's death (2014) removes the last Pakistani check on the ISI network.
phases.operative_note: Rizwan Shah is Hamza's parallel-track operative — different cover identity, same Sanyal handler. Film 2 confirms the dual-operative structure established in rizwan-partnership-activation.

adversary_network_map.description: The full Karachi-Lyari-ISI nexus Hamza is mapping
adversary_network_map.oracle_note: This full network map is used by intel_network_node (SNA) to compute betweenness centrality. Major Iqbal has the highest betweenness — he is the broker connecting ISI to criminal, political, and operational layers. Removing him collapses the network.
